healthy.description: Running nodes without alarms, partitions or failing health checks

recvRate.description: Bytes per second from the client

sendRate.description: Bytes per second to the client

status.description: up, single_active (the active one) or waiting

role.description: Limit the token to this role; defaults to your role

token.description: The token value. It is only shown once.

type.description: basic: username and password; bearer: an OAuth2 access token for brokers whose management API uses OAuth2

id.description: Slug; derived from name when empty

change.description: conflict: the object exists with other properties and import will not change it; cluster-only: import never deletes

kind.description: vhosts, users, permissions, topic_permissions, policies, parameters, global_parameters, exchanges, queues or bindings

counts.description: Number of changes by change type

definitions.description: A RabbitMQ definitions export (whole cluster, or one vhost when vhost is set)

vhost.description: Compare and import against this vhost; the file is a vhost export

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

name.description: Empty for the default exchange, which paths address as amq.default

definitions.description: A RabbitMQ definitions export (whole cluster, or one vhost when vhost is set)

select.description: Change ids from diff-definitions; empty imports every added and changed object

vhost.description: Compare and import against this vhost; the file is a vhost export

role.description: Effective role (an API token may be limited below its user's role)

applyTo.description: all, queues, classic_queues, quorum_queues, streams or exchanges

pattern.description: Regular expression matched against queue or exchange names

name.description: The policy's name, so an existing policy of that name is replaced in the comparison

credential.description: Publish as this credential profile instead of the management user

routed.description: False when no binding matched; the message was dropped or went to an alternate exchange's queues only if one is configured

expiration.description: Per-message TTL in milliseconds, as a string

type.description: direct, fanout, topic, headers, or a plugin type from the cluster info

consumerCapacity.description: 0..1: how often the queue could deliver to consumers immediately

effectivePolicy.description: Policy and operator policy keys in effect

durable.description: Defaults to true. RabbitMQ 4.x refuses non-durable, non-exclusive queues unless the deprecated transient_nonexcl_queues feature is permitted.

node.description: Node for a classic queue, or the leader of a quorum queue or stream

noPassword.description: Create the user without a password (certificate or OAuth2 login only)

passwordHash.description: A hash from POST /api/auth/hash_password or another cluster's definitions

tags.description: administrator, monitoring, policymaker, management, impersonator, or custom tags

deliver.description: Deliveries to consumers with manual ack

deliverNoAck.description: Deliveries to consumers with automatic ack

queues.description: The deepest queues (up to 500 inspected), plus any with problems

needsSetup.description: True when no users exist and the first admin can be created with POST /v1/setup

canMonitor.description: The user can see every vhost's objects (administrator or monitoring tag)

nodeStates.description: Whether the vhost runs on each node

defaultQueueType.description: Queue type for declarations that do not name one
